O01: hood may cover the rear and sides of the head but not the face; sleeves and trousers may cover arms and legs normally
O03: suit jacket may cover shirt torso while collar, tie, jacket lapels, cuffs, and trouser separation remain legible
O04: bomber jacket may cover the inner shirt except at the intended opening; jeans may cover legs to ankle level

never_allowed: face covered by garment or artifact
camera crop removes any body part

shared_allowed.scope: garment may cover the body regions it is designed to cover; body silhouette must remain anatomically coherent
an arm may naturally occlude a small torso or garment region in the frozen pose
far-side limbs and garment surfaces may be self-occluded in side/back views
trousers or jeans may cover legs to the ankles without deleting feet
